controller_spec.description: Deterministic interpretable instance-adaptive hyper-heuristic controller over a frozen TSP portfolio; emphasizes broad coverage on diversity failures while using structure cues for selection and bounded online schedule tuning.
controller_spec.name: tsp_hh_portfolio_v3_deterministic_diversity_failure

mapping.candidate_limit_offset: candidate_list_pruning / candidate list size tightening when present; otherwise treated as a mild intensity proxy in the controller schedule
mapping.restart_offset: number of restart/perturbation cycles in heuristics that support restart/perturbation

deterministic_tuning_interpretation.notes: All tuning is interpreted as bounded deterministic schedule adjustments for the chosen heuristic; no new low-level operators are introduced.

diversity_guard.action: use random_like_heuristic for one scheduled phase, then return to selected base heuristic
diversity_guard.rule: If non-improving streak >= 2 and failure-archive diversity <= 0.18, then run random_like_heuristic once at the next stagnation checkpoint (do not switch to stagnation_switch_heuristic).

candidate_limit_formula.late_adjust: (-1 if recent improvement rate <= low_improvement_threshold else 0)

restart_intensity_formula.offset: restart_offset + (1 if stagnation length >= stagnation_threshold else 0) + (1 if failed perturbation count >= failed_perturbation_threshold else 0) - (1 if recent improvement rate > low_improvement_threshold else 0)

candidate_limit_formula.offset: candidate_limit_offset + (1 if grid-likeness >= 0.45 else -1) - (1 if time budget used >= time_budget_trigger else 0) + (-1 if recent improvement rate <= low_improvement_threshold else 0)

restart_intensity_formula.offset: restart_offset + (1 if failed perturbation count >= failed_perturbation_threshold else 0) - (1 if recent improvement rate > low_improvement_threshold else 0)

then.candidate_list_action: tighten candidate list deterministically by -1 step (expressed via candidate_limit_offset effect)

failed_perturbation_count_action.do: increase restart intensity deterministically by +1 step

Research goal:
- Approach the oracle heuristic portfolio on unseen held-out TSPLIB instances.

- farthest_insertion_two_opt: Farthest-insertion construction followed by 2-opt clean-up. | components=farthest_insertion, 2_opt
